```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Republican Party supports reforming the immigration system to ensure it is legal, safe, orderly and humane.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party supports measures to ensure the immigration system is structured to address the needs of national security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America is a stronger and better nation because of the hard work and entrepreneurial spirit of immigrants, according to the Republican Party.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party honors immigrants.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A growing economy requires a growing number of workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush proposed a new temporary worker program that applies when no Americans can be found to fill the jobs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The proposed temporary worker program would allow workers who currently hold jobs to come out of the shadows and to participate legally in America's economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The proposed temporary worker program would allow men and women who enter the program to apply for citizenship in the same manner as those who apply from outside the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There must be strong workplace enforcement with tough penalties against employees and employers who violate immigration laws.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party opposes amnesty because it would encourage illegal immigration.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party opposes amnesty because it would give an unfair advantage to those who have broken the laws.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
